findings.evidence: Lines 39-41: `simp [frameVector_def, minkowskiProduct_basis_left, hij, hij.symm, minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0, minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i]` then `ring`.
findings.fix: Replace with `simp only [frameVector_def, minkowskiProduct_basis_left, hij, hij.symm, minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0, minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i, ...]` (adding whatever further lemmas the `simp only` reports as needed) followed by `ring`.
findings.issue: `minkowskiProduct_frameVector` uses a non-terminal full `simp [...]` whose residual goal is closed by `ring`. The default simp set shapes that residue, so an upstream simp-set change either breaks `ring` or closes the goal and makes `ring` fail with "no goals". This lemma underpins every step of `exists_of_mem_physicalRegion`.

findings.evidence: Line 297 `refine ⟨⟨_, _, _, hp, hp', hnn, by rw [hnp]; linarith, by rw [hnp']; linarith⟩, ?_, ?_⟩`; comment lines 268-269 name `P`, `Δ`, `C`, `E`, none of which occur in lines 270-306.
findings.fix: Bind the three vectors (e.g. `set p₀ := frameVector i j (A - ξ * B) (-D / 2) (B - ξ * A)`, likewise `p₀'` and `n₀`), pass them explicitly in the `refine`, and rewrite the comment in terms of `p₀`, `p₀'`, `n₀` — stating why `A`, `B`, `D` take those values (`P⁺ = A - B = 1`, `P² = M² - t/4`, `D² = -((1 - ξ²)t + 4ξ²M²)`).
findings.issue: The witness of `exists_of_mem_physicalRegion` is built as `⟨_, _, _, hp, hp', hnn, ...⟩`: the `p`, `p'`, `n` fields are never written, only back-inferred by unification against `hp`/`hp'`/`hnn`, and the two remaining goals need bare `dsimp only` (lines 299, 304) to re-expose them. The structuring comment at lines 268-269 describes `P = A e₀ + B eⱼ` and `Δ = C e₀ + D eᵢ + E eⱼ`, but `P`, `Δ`, `C`, `E` are not bound anywhere in the proof, so the only in-script account of the construction does not match what is constructed.

summary: Two proof-robustness issues: a non-terminal default `simp` before `ring` in the reusable frame-vector product lemma, and an explicit-construction proof whose witnesses are hidden behind `_` with a structuring comment that names variables the script never binds.
